data.long_meaning: Al-Baraka is derived from the Arabic root 'B-R-K' meaning 'to bless'. It refers to the manifestation of God's blessings in one's life, invoking the idea of prosperity and divine favor. The name AlBaraka carries the meaning “God's blessings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlBaraka usually hope their child will grow to embody god's blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
